            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if self.inside(nr, nc) and self.g[nr][nc] is None:
                out.append((nr, nc))
        return out

    def all_caps(self, turn, chain=None):
        if chain:
            return [(chain, t) for t in self.caps_from(*chain)]
        return [((r, c), t) for r in range(8) for c in range(8)
                if self.g[r][c] and self.g[r][c][0] == turn
                for t in self.caps_from(r, c)]

    def all_steps(self, turn):
        return [((r, c), t) for r in range(8) for c in range(8)
                if self.g[r][c] and self.g[r][c][0] == turn
                for t in self.steps_from(r, c)]

    def apply(self, f, t):
        """Execute a move; returns (was_capture, just_kinged)."""
        fr, fc = f
        tr, tc = t
        p = self.g[fr][fc]
        man = p in ('w', 'b')
        self.g[fr][fc] = None
        jumped = None
        if abs(tr - fr) == 2:
            jumped = self.g[(fr + tr) // 2][(fc + tc) // 2]
            self.g[(fr + tr) // 2][(fc + tc) // 2] = None
        if p == 'w' and tr == 0:
            p = 'W'
        elif p == 'b' and tr == 7:
            p = 'B'
        self.g[tr][tc] = p
        return jumped is not None, man and p in ('W', 'B')


def main():
    board = Board()
    turn, chain = 'w', None
    name = {'w': 'White', 'b': 'Black'}
    print("=== Checkers (Draughts) ===")
    print("White moves first. Enter moves as from-to squares, e.g. b6-a5.")
    print("Type 'quit' to exit. Captures are mandatory; multi-jumps continue.")
    while True:
        board.show()
        caps = board.all_caps(turn, chain)
        steps = [] if (caps or chain) else board.all_steps(turn)
        if not caps and not steps:
            print("\nGame over — %s wins! %s has no legal moves."
                  % (name[other(turn)], name[turn]))
            return
        hint = " (must jump again from %s)" % sq(chain) if chain else ""
        raw = input("%s%s to move [e.g. b6-a5]: " % (name[turn], hint)).strip().lower()
        if raw in ('quit', 'exit', 'q'):
            print("Game abandoned. Goodbye!")
            return
        parts = [t for t in re.split(r'[^a-h1-8]', raw) if t]
        if len(parts) != 2:
            print("  Invalid input — enter two squares, e.g. b6-a5.\n")
            continue
        f, t = pos(parts[0]), pos(parts[1])
        if f is None or t is None:
            print("  Bad square — columns a-h, rows 1-8.\n")
            continue
        piece = board.g[f[0]][f[1]]
        if piece is None or piece[0] != turn:
            print("  No friendly piece on the source square.\n")
            continue
        if chain and f != chain:
            print("  You must keep jumping with the piece on %s.\n" % sq(chain))
            continue
        if t in [dest for _, dest in caps]:
            was_cap, kinged = board.apply(f, t)
            if was_cap and board.caps_from(*t) and not kinged:
                chain = t
                print("  Capture! %s must jump again.\n" % name[turn])
            else:

        elif t in [dest for _, dest in steps]:
            board.apply(f, t)
            chain = None
            turn = other(turn)
        elif caps:

        else:
            print("  Illegal move — pieces slide one diagonal step (men forward only).\n")


if __name__ == '__main__':
